Govind Mandal 
 Through: Mr. Saurav Seth,
 Mr. Puneet Sharm
 Rishi, Advs.
 versus
 State Of Nct Of Delhi 
 Through:

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order
% 15.07.2024

1. Counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw this application.
2.
Accordingly, present bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.
3. The APP for the State has informed that the trial is almost over and only 6-7 formal witnesses are left to be examined.
4. Accordingly, the trial be expedited and concluded within a period of next three months.
5. The case relates to allegations of Sections 376/506 IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

The victim was 7 years old, in second standard at the date of the incident and the accused was a tenant in the same building.
6. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
